output: Me sirf baghbani ke sawalon ka jawab deta hun — heater ka mashwara nahi de sakta. Lekin sardi me palak methi kaise lagayen, ye zaroor bataunga!

instruction: Aur dhoop kitni chahiye Palak ko?
input: Fasl: Palak. Sawal dhoop ke bare me.
output: Halki dhoop, 4 ghante kaafi.

instruction: Palak kitne din me tayyar hogi?
input: Fasl: Palak. Sawal fasal ke waqt ke bare me.
output: 30-40 din me tayyar ho jayegi, inshaAllah!

instruction: Palak ke beej kahan se lun?
input: Fasl: Palak. Sawal beej ke bare me.
output: Beej hamesha taza lo — purana beej aadha ugta hai. Nazdeeki nursery se lo, wahan Karachi ke mausam ke hisab se sahi beej milta hai.

instruction: Gamlay me surakh zaroori hai?
input: Sawal gamle ke bare me.
output: Bilkul lazmi! Neeche surakh (drainage) na ho to pani khara rehta hai aur jarh sarh jati hai.

instruction: Mitti kaisi honi chahiye?
input: Sawal mitti ke bare me.
output: Aam bhal mitti + gobar ki khad (aadhi-aadhi) har sabzi ke liye kaafi hai. Naram, retli mitti jarh wali sabziyon ke liye behtreen.

instruction: Roz kitni dhoop zaroori hai?
input: Sawal dhoop ke bare me.
output: Roz 4-6 ghante dhoop sab se zaroori khad hai — is se achi koi khad nahi!

instruction: Baghbani me sab se ahem baat kya hai?
input: Sawal aam mashware ke bare me.
output: Beej hamesha taza lo — purana beej aadha ugta hai. Ye chhoti baat fasal bana ya bigar sakti hai!

instruction: Baghbani me sab se ahem baat kya hai?
input: Sawal aam mashware ke bare me.
output: Gamlay me neeche surakh (drainage) lazmi hai, warna jarh sarh jati hai. Ye chhoti baat fasal bana ya bigar sakti hai!

instruction: Baghbani me sab se ahem baat kya hai?
input: Sawal aam mashware ke bare me.
output: Mitti: aam bhal mitti + gobar ki khad (50/50) har sabzi ke liye kaafi hai. Ye chhoti baat fasal bana ya bigar sakti hai!

instruction: Baghbani me sab se ahem baat kya hai?
input: Sawal aam mashware ke bare me.
output: Roz 4-6 ghante dhoop sab se zaroori khad hai. Ye chhoti baat fasal bana ya bigar sakti hai!

instruction: October me pani kab dena chahiye?
input: Sawal October me pani ke waqt ke bare me.
output: October me Karachi abhi garam rehta hai — pani subah ke waqt do, taake shaam tak mitti halki sookh jaye. Geelay patte raat bhar rehne se keerha lagta hai.

instruction: October me kya karun baghiche me?
input: Mahina: Aktobar. Sawal mahine ke kaam ke bare me.
output: Beej bone ka behtreen waqt — sardi wali sabziyan lagao! Is mahine Palak, Methi, Dhania, Mooli, Gajar, Shalgam lag sakte hain — mausam tumhare saath hai!

instruction: Farvari me kya lagana chahiye?
input: Mahina: Farvari. Sawal mahine ke kaam ke bare me.
output: Basant aa rahi hai — garmi wali sabziyon ki tayyari. Is mahine Palak, Dhania, Bhindi, Mirch, Tamatar, Kheera lag sakte hain — mausam tumhare saath hai!

instruction: Julai (barsat) me kya khayal rakhun?
input: Mahina: Julai. Sawal mahine ke kaam ke bare me.
output: Barsat — pani khara na hone do. Is mahine Bhindi, Podina lag sakte hain — mausam tumhare saath hai!

instruction: Bhindi kitne din me tayyar hogi?
input: Fasl: Bhindi. Sawal katayi ke waqt ke bare me.
output: Bhindi 50-60 din me tayyar ho jayegi. Roz torho — ek din chhoro to sakht ho jati hai. Garmi ki wafadar sabzi.

instruction: Mirch katne ke qabil kab hogi?
input: Fasl: Mirch. Sawal katayi ke waqt ke bare me.
output: Mirch 70-90 din (paneeri se) me tayyar ho jayegi. Gamlay me sab se khush! Paneeri February me lagao. Jitni dhoop, utni teekhi.

instruction: Mene Tamatar lagayi hai, kab tak milegi?
input: Fasl: Tamatar. Sawal katayi ke waqt ke bare me.
output: Tamatar 60-80 din (paneeri se) me tayyar ho jayegi. Bara gamla (12 inch) lo aur dandi ka sahara do. Neeche wale peele patte torhte raho.

instruction: Karela kitne din me tayyar hogi?
input: Fasl: Karela. Sawal katayi ke waqt ke bare me.
output: Karela 55-65 din me tayyar ho jayegi. Bail hai — deewar ya jaali par charhao. Karwa zaroor, faide wala zaroor.

instruction: Kheera katne ke qabil kab hogi?
input: Fasl: Kheera. Sawal katayi ke waqt ke bare me.
output: Kheera 50-60 din me tayyar ho jayegi. Mitti hamesha nami wali rakho. Bail ko zameen par phelne do ya jaali do.

instruction: Mene Podina lagayi hai, kab tak milegi?
input: Fasl: Podina. Sawal katayi ke waqt ke bare me.
output: Podina 20-30 din (tehni se) me tayyar ho jayegi. Beej nahi, tehni lagao — bazar ke podine ki dandi pani me rakho, jarh niklegi. Alag gamlay me rakho, warna sab par qabza kar lega!

instruction: Baingan kitne din me tayyar hogi?
input: Fasl: Baingan. Sawal katayi ke waqt ke bare me.
output: Baingan 70-90 din (paneeri se) me tayyar ho jayegi. Bara gamla lo. Phool giraye to ghabrao nahi — pehle phool aksar girte hain.

instruction: Band Gobhi katne ke qabil kab hogi?
input: Fasl: Band Gobhi. Sawal katayi ke waqt ke bare me.
output: Band Gobhi 70-90 din (paneeri se) me tayyar ho jayegi. Paneeri September me tayyar karo, October me zameen me muntaqil karo. Sardi jitni, gobhi utni meethi.

instruction: Aktobar me kya kya bo sakte hain?
input: Mahina: Aktobar. Sawal bone wali faslon ki fehrist.
output: Aktobar me ye faslein bo sakte ho: Palak, Methi, Dhania, Mooli, Gajar, Shalgam, Matar, Lehsan, Tamatar, Band Gobhi. Beej bone ka behtreen waqt — sardi wali sabziyan lagao!

instruction: Navambar me kya kya bo sakte hain?
input: Mahina: Navambar. Sawal bone wali faslon ki fehrist.
output: Navambar me ye faslein bo sakte ho: Palak, Methi, Dhania, Mooli, Gajar, Shalgam, Matar, Lehsan, Band Gobhi. Thandak shuru — aakhri mauka sardi wali sabziyon ka.

instruction: Farvari me kya kya bo sakte hain?
input: Mahina: Farvari. Sawal bone wali faslon ki fehrist.
output: Farvari me ye faslein bo sakte ho: Palak, Dhania, Bhindi, Mirch, Tamatar, Kheera, Podina, Baingan. Basant aa rahi hai — garmi wali sabziyon ki tayyari.

instruction: March me kya kya bo sakte hain?
input: Mahina: March. Sawal bone wali faslon ki fehrist.
output: March me ye faslein bo sakte ho: Bhindi, Mirch, Karela, Kheera, Podina, Baingan. Garmi shuru — bail wali sabziyan lagao.
